next.reason: The 1985 rule only makes the relative BLOCK CONTAINS clause the sequential one. 2023 writes one BLOCK CONTAINS clause (13.18.10) into FD Format 1 (sequential, §2023:13.4.5.3 SR5) and Format 2 ('for a relative file or an indexed file', §2023:13.4.5.3 SR7). The clause's own rules are the sequential BLOCK CONTAINS record's content.
